gameDescriptionHtml:
A Sci-Fi colony and strategy sim with a complex economy, immersive logistics, and a war against the rise of the machines! Build your colony and ensure supplies for your people. Automate industrial ships and create combat groups to defend against waves of enemies.

Game Features

  • We are here to build a thriving colony – Choose your story and location for a future colony, and embark on an exciting expedition filled with economic and industrial challenges. Protect your people from the artificial intelligence enslaving the world.
  • Assemble a fleet of modular ships – Build new ships and combine different modules—your actions are limited only by technological progress and available resources. Each ship is equipped with an artificial intelligence system based on task assignments that depend on the installed modules. Ships remember where you send them and strive to form the behavior patterns you need.
  • Meet the needs of its people – Your people need resources, without which they will leave the colony. Maintain their well-being, as your colony’s production and progress depend on them.
  • Create an autonomous colony – Design optimal districts that can operate stably even during the toughest crises. Use all available tools: establish logistics between warehouses, trade, create reserves, and pass necessary laws.
  • Use strategy to become better – Adopt pacts and objectives that will temporarily or even permanently improve your colony. Choose carefully, as such major decisions can only be made rarely.
  • Earn a fortune through trade – Automate trade with other colonies and trade networks, find the most profitable routes, and speculate on the market. Unlock new opportunities through diplomatic objectives and pacts.
  • Protect your fleet and colony – Oblivion enslaves weak colonies and sends them to attack others. You will need to assemble your own battle fleet to counter these assaults and defend against the rise of the machines.
  • Infected Nodes of Oblivion – Oblivion attacks your buildings and ships using viruses, causing you to temporarily lose control over them. Destroy the nodes using offensive pacts, or protect your base with Firewall-equipped buildings.
